divergence_probe.description: DIVERGENCE PROBE (CF-C2-FIXTURE-PROOF-1): the test MUST verify that string path gives expected_minor_units AND Number()*Math.round gives number_path_wrong_result. A green CI without this probe does NOT discharge CF-C2-STRING-API-1.
divergence_probe.divergence_explanation: float('1234.565')*100 = 123456.5 exactly in IEEE-754. ROUND_HALF_EVEN: floor=123456 is EVEN → stay at 123456. Math.round (ROUND_HALF_UP, legacy): 123456.5 rounds UP to 123457. These DIFFER by 1 paise per occurrence. The string path is CORRECT; the Number() path is WRONG for EVEN-floor ties.
divergence_probe.bit_pattern_argument: Decimal('1234.565') * 100 = Decimal('123456.5') exactly (rational arithmetic). float('1234.565') * 100 = 123456.5 in IEEE-754 double (this happens to be representable exactly because 1234565/10 = 123456.5 = 247213/2 which has a finite binary expansion: 0x40FE244000000000). Math.round(123456.5) = 123457 (ties round to +infinity in JS). ROUND_HALF_EVEN(123456.5) = 123456 (floor 123456 is even). Delta = 1.

high_volume_cogs.description: CF-C2-FLOAT-COGS-1: 10001 line items at coq='123.4567' (Decimal(12,4)). Brain per-item integer path is exact. This documents the per-item-rounding accumulation artifact class.
high_volume_cogs.note: Brain path: each item converts to 12346 paise (ROUND_HALF_EVEN: 12345.67 → floor=12345 ODD → round up to 12346). Sum = 10001 × 12346 = 123472346. Float path: 123.4567 × 100 = 12345.67 per float, accumulated = 123469045.67, Math.round = 123469046. Delta = 3300 paise. This is a KNOWN rounding-accumulation artifact (NOT a float-ULP error): Brain rounds per-item to the nearest paise; the legacy float accumulates fractional paise and rounds once at the end. Both are internally consistent; the Brain path is the correct paise-canonical path per M-A5-Q2. Classified as CF-C2-FLOAT-COGS-1 artifact, not BLOCKING_BUG.
